title: What If Every Roof on Earth Were Painted White?

scenes.text: What if every dark roof on Earth were painted white? Your roof would notice within minutes.
In August, a white roof runs only about ten degrees Fahrenheit above the air. A black paint roof runs fifty hotter.
That cuts air conditioning. California's energy chief put the savings at around twenty percent.
Cities cool too. New York's cool and green roof push is projected to lower temperatures by one to one and a half degrees.
A single thousand-square-foot white roof offsets about ten tons of carbon dioxide over twenty years.
Whiten every eligible flat urban roof, and researchers estimate twenty-four billion tons of CO2 offset. Paint, doing climate work.
